step: Check the inlet pressure gauge before touching anything else
rationale: If the inlet is already low the fault is upstream and nothing on this machine will fix it.
failure_indicator: Needle sitting below the green band at idle
evidence: first I look at the inlet gauge because if it is low the problem is upstream

step: Tap the relief valve body with the screwdriver handle
rationale: A stuck valve sounds dull and a free one rings; it has caused this fault before.
failure_indicator: Dull sound on tapping and the pressure needle oscillating
evidence: a stuck valve sounds dull and a free one rings

step: Feel the return hose for heat along its length
rationale: A hot spot means fluid is bypassing somewhere it should not.
failure_indicator: One section much warmer than the rest
evidence: if one part of the hose is hot the fluid is bypassing

step: Listen to the pump with the motor running before opening the casing
rationale: Cavitation has a gravel sound you can hear before any damage shows.
failure_indicator: Rattling like gravel inside the pump
evidence: it sounds like gravel in there that is cavitation

rationale: A clogged filter starves the pump and looks like a pump fault.
evidence: a blocked filter looks exactly like a bad pump so check the indicator

step: Torque the valve cover bolts in a cross pattern
rationale: Tightening in a circle warps the cover and it leaks again within a week.
failure_indicator: Weeping oil at one corner of the cover
evidence: do it in a cross pattern or the cover warps and leaks again
